OpenVisionLab 3D Studio Viewer - third-party dependency attribution
=====================================================================

Bundle scope: OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Viewer, .NET 10 WPF, win-x64.
This file is copied into the Viewer dependency bundle and is covered by
viewer-dll-manifest.json. The machine-readable component map is
VIEWER_DEPENDENCY_ATTRIBUTION.json.

This is a provenance and attribution record for the current source-tree bundle. It is
not legal advice, a warranty, or public-release approval. Keep this file, the
JSON map, LICENSE, NOTICE, and the complete source/license records named below
with every extracted bundle.

OpenVisionLab projects
----------------------
OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Viewer, OpenVisionLab.Localization,
OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Core, OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Data,
OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Presentation, and OpenVisionLab.ThreeD.Tools are built
from this repository. They are covered by the repository Apache-2.0 LICENSE
and NOTICE. The bundle manifest identifies the source-tree commit for each
build.

OpenVisionLab Vision SDK packages
--------------------------------
OpenVisionLab.Core 3.0.1-dev.20260823.grid-diagnostics.1 and
OpenVisionLab.Vision2D 3.0.1-dev.20260823.grid-diagnostics.1 are MIT-licensed
packages from https://github.com/Noah8218/OpenVisionLab-Vision-SDK at commit
8be38403d0d00698431d7ffa4de60a63289672c6. OpenVisionLab.Vision3D
3.0.1-dev.20260829.normal-preparation.1 is MIT-licensed from the same
repository at commit 6da3bcf521efb88681a17e4a7b23a091e7fcbacf. Their package
LICENSE and NOTICE files were inspected; package SHA-256 and SHA-512 values
are recorded in VIEWER_DEPENDENCY_ATTRIBUTION.json.

OpenCvSharp, OpenCV, and cvBlob
-------------------------------
OpenVisionLab.Core embeds OpenCvSharp.dll, OpenCvSharp.Blob.dll, and the
win-x64 OpenCvSharpExtern.dll. The managed OpenCvSharp assembly identifies
source commit daa955c6e0263a7ba201404e5aa72f4c1bd144ae and is covered by the
BSD-3-Clause license at:
https://github.com/shimat/opencvsharp/blob/daa955c6e0263a7ba201404e5aa72f4c1bd144ae/LICENSE

The native binary contains the OpenCV 4.3.0 configuration string and revision
4.3.0-1-gd40fe356e3. OpenCV 4.3.0 uses the 3-clause BSD license:
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.3.0/LICENSE

OpenCvSharp.Blob's source ReadMe.txt says that it wraps cvblob and that the
cvblob/OpenCvSharp path is LGPL, but it does not specify an LGPL version. The
maintained cvBlob source mirror publishes the corresponding license records:
https://github.com/Steelskin/cvblob/blob/main/COPYING
https://github.com/Steelskin/cvblob/blob/main/COPYING.LESSER
The license version and any source/relink obligations for a public release
must be confirmed by the owner before redistribution. Do not treat the Core
package's MIT metadata as overriding these embedded component records.

SharpGL
-------
SharpGL, SharpGL.SceneGraph, and SharpGL.WPF 3.1.1 are from
https://github.com/dwmkerr/sharpgl and use its MIT license:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dwmkerr/sharpgl/master/LICENSE
The NuGet nuspecs do not encode a source commit; the package SHA values and
the repository URL are retained in the JSON map.

LASzip
------
Unofficial.laszip.netstandard 5.6.2 is from
https://github.com/aardvark-platform/aardvark.algodat and its package points
to the upstream LGPL-2.1 license:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aardvark-platform/aardvark.algodat/master/src/Unofficial.laszip.netstandard/LICENSE
Keep the LGPL terms and the applicable source/replacement path when this DLL
is redistributed.

Assets considered but not delivered
------------------------------------
System.Data.DataSetExtensions 4.5.0 appears in project.assets.json but no
assembly from that package is present in the Viewer bundle. Its package
LICENSE.TXT and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT remain an assets-only record in the
JSON map and are not represented as delivered payloads.

Extraction checklist
--------------------
1. Keep every file named by viewer-dll-manifest.json, including this file and
   VIEWER_DEPENDENCY_ATTRIBUTION.json, beside the managed assemblies.
2. Preserve runtimes/win-x64/native/OpenCvSharpExtern.dll exactly; its native
   OpenCV dependency is not replaced by copying Viewer.dll alone.
3. Retain the cited license and attribution sources and resolve the cvBlob
   LGPL version/source question before any public or commercial redistribution.
4. Verify every manifest hash and run scripts/verify-viewer-dll-host.ps1
   against the exact extracted directory.
